name: Almost Elton & Almost Billy

evidence.note: Library lists the Oct 4, 2-3:30 PM show in a lecture room as a sing-along with a band and costume changes; registration was full.
Band's own schedule lists the Oct 4 Dix Hills library show, which confirms this is the right Almost Elton.
Same show played the Smithtown Center for the Performing Arts, a seated theater, in Feb 2026.

dancing.notes: A sit-down tribute concert. The Dix Hills library show is in a lecture room, and the library invites people to sing along, not to dance.

description: A New York tribute act that plays the piano hits of Elton John and Billy Joel in one show, backed by a band and with costume changes.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Other Elton tributes use the 'Almost Elton' name (e.g., a Memphis band at almostelton.com). Chose the NY band because its site lists this exact library date. Rating is based on venue and format; no crowd video watched.
